 Chad Hutchinson – Professional Athlete to Professional Investor in Sports (EP.351) 
 
 Chad Hutchinson – Professional Athlete to Professional Investor in Sports (EP.351) Nov 20, 2023

 Chad Hutchinson is a partner at Arctos Partners, a private
equity firm best known as the leading minority owner of
professional sports franchises. Chad was one of only seven athletes
since 1970 to play in both Major League Baseball and the National
Football League. After his sports career ended, he started from
scratch in finance and spent fifteen years in private markets
before joining Arctos and bringing his two careers together.

 

We discuss Chad’s journey to two professional sports, mindset and
framework for success, transition and career in finance, blend of
his two paths at Arctos, and interdisciplinary learnings across
fields.

 

Set all your assumptions about athletes and private equity managers
aside as you listen to this incredible story of Chad’s
determination, humility, intelligence, and drive.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
